polaris: LP29-C2 graph metrics 是否只是 Srivastava orbital-overlap metric 的重参数化。
framework: Baseline-first amorphous oxide/oxynitride electronic-structure audit: Srivastava normalized orbital overlap and controls must precede any graph residual test.
findings: Round 3 converts the C2 A-side scaffold into executable baseline/provenance artifacts. Four Srivastava rows are now filled from Table II and the Fig. 4 text: a-IGZO-1114, a-IGZO-2217, a-ZnON-21, and a-ZnON-11. These rows establish an orbital-overlap/effective-mass baseline table, not a graph-residual validation. The forbidden-control prose is normalized into CSV rules, including an executable fixed-pair versus fixed-density OI rule. Jankousky and Furubayashi remain blocked for same-sample external residual tests until their labels, structures, and provenance are joined.
weakest_link: The Srivastava rows are reported-table baseline rows, not recomputed structure rows. Graph metrics, same-sample residuals, and external residual labels remain missing, so no claim that graph residual power survives OI_norm + controls is allowed.
next_plan: Use these rows as the locked OI/m_eff baseline. Next, acquire schema-compatible Jankousky/Furubayashi external-label rows with exact sample joins or preserve blocked provenance; only then run train-fold residualization and held-out graph residual tests.
literature_needed: Jankousky 2026 same-sample a-In2O3 structures/labels/SI; Furubayashi 2019 Hall/transport digitized rows with thickness, carrier density, mobility, and density provenance; Srivastava SI-III if recomputation rather than reported-table use is required.

srivastava_baseline_rows.normalization: Table II reports total normalized orbital overlap integral as Number of Pairs * OI / volume, summed over all listed metal-cation pairs for a-IGZO and single Zn-Zn pair class for a-ZnON.
srivastava_baseline_rows.claim_status: baseline rows only; not graph validation

forbidden_control_rules.execution_semantics: For a requested target_type, downstream code should reject any feature column whose namespace and column name match a rule row unless the rationale states an explicit allowed residualization condition and that condition is present in the model registry.
major_blocks: graph independent claims before OI and null residualization

oi_fixed_pair_vs_fixed_density_rule.fixed_pair_rule: If the compared samples have the same declared N_pair and pair set class, use OI_pair_mean = sum(Pairs_ab * OI_ab) / N_pair and do not interpret OI_raw_sum as a density effect.
oi_fixed_pair_vs_fixed_density_rule.fixed_density_rule: If N_pair changes with volume, composition, or cutoff, use OI_norm = sum(Pairs_ab * OI_ab) / volume and include pair_density as a control or matching variable before testing graph metrics.
oi_fixed_pair_vs_fixed_density_rule.failure_action: If neither fixed-pair nor fixed-density condition is satisfied, graph metrics may be computed as diagnostics but cannot be used for an independent residual-power claim.
